query: Create a policy that only allows ETH transfers to 0xabc and 0xdef
expected_behavior: Uses eth.tx.to condition with the specified addresses

query: Set up guardrails for my agent wallet so it can only interact with a specific Solana program
expected_behavior: References solana.tx.program_keys or solana.tx.instructions in the condition
Scopes the consensus to the agent user ID

query: List all policies in my organization and delete the one named test-policy
expected_behavior: Calls deletePolicy with the correct policyId

query: Block all transaction signing in my organization
expected_behavior: Creates a DENY policy targeting activity.action == 'SIGN'
Warns about the impact of a blanket deny
Suggests keeping an ALLOW escape path for admin users

query: Require two admins to approve any wallet export
expected_behavior: Uses EFFECT_ALLOW with the multi-sig consensus

query: Cap Bitcoin transaction fees at 50000 satoshis
expected_behavior: Notes that values are in satoshis
